title: Jetson Light Rider 12-Inch Kids' Light-up Bike (Green)
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match: ASIN B0BXTVV16W is the green 12-inch Jetson Light Rider, model JLRG12-GRN, UPC 840290207983.

comparisons.notes: Manufacturer product data identifies green variant JLRG12-GRN, UPC 840290207983, as available. Shipping is additional.

writeup: Woot has a new Jetson Light Rider 12-inch kids' light-up bike in green for $49.99. This is model JLRG12-GRN with UPC 840290207983, and it includes light-up training wheels and an adjustable seat. Jetson's own site lists that same green bike in stock at $179.99, though shipping is additional there. That is about 72 percent below the manufacturer's current price and saves roughly $130. Woot showed only 1 left with a limit of 10 per customer.
